parameters.jsCode:
const items = $input.all().map(i => i.json); const date = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); const discrepancies = items.filter(i => i.Overall_Status !== 'Fully Balanced'); const balanced = items.filter(i => i.Overall_Status === 'Fully Balanced'); const statusColor = (status) => { if (status === 'Total Mismatch') return '#c0392b'; return '#e67e22'; }; const thStyle = `background:#2c2c2c;color:#fff;padding:8px 12px;text-align:left;`; const tdStyle = `padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e0e0e0;`; const buildDiscrepancyRows = (rows) => rows.map((r, i) => ` ${r.WarehouseCode} ${r.SKUName} ${r.PhysicalCount ?? 'N/A'} ${r.BinCardBalance ?? 'Not Recorded'} ${r.NAVQuantity ?? 'Not Found'} ${r.Overall_Status} `).join(''); const buildBalancedRows = (rows) => rows.map((r, i) => ` ${r.WarehouseCode} ${r.SKUName} ${r.PhysicalCount ?? 'N/A'} ${r.BinCardBalance ?? 'N/A'} ${r.NAVQuantity ?? 'N/A'} `).join(''); const html = `

📦 Daily Stock Audit Report

${date}

Total Audited: ${items.length}  |  Fully Balanced: ${balanced.length}  |  Requiring Attention: ${discrepancies.length}
${discrepancies.length === 0 ? '

✅ All items are fully balanced today. No action required.

' : `

⚠️ Items Requiring Attention

${buildDiscrepancyRows(discrepancies)}
Warehouse SKU Physical Count Bin Card Balance NAV Count Status
` } ${balanced.length > 0 ? `

✅ Fully Balanced

${buildBalancedRows(balanced)}
Warehouse SKU Physical Count Bin Card Balance NAV Count
` : ''}

This report was generated automatically by the ODL Stock Audit System.

`; return [{ json: { emailBody: html, date } }];
